raw_problem.problem_text:
(a) $t$ 时刻，对自旋角动量沿 $x$ 方向的分量进行测量，求得到结果为 $+ \hbar / 2$ 的几率.  
(b) 同样的问题，如果沿 $y$ 方向结果是什么?  
(c) 同样的问题，改为沿 $z$ 方向.
raw_problem.solution_text:
例题 4.3 中的自旋态为

$$
\chi \left(t\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c} \cos \left(\alpha / 2\right)   \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \\ \sin \left(\alpha / 2\right)   \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \end{array} \right).
$$

$S _ { x }$ $S _ { y }$ $S _ { z }$ 本征值为 $+ \hbar / 2$ 的本征态分别为

$$
\chi_ {+} ^ {(x)} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right), \quad \chi_ {+} ^ {(y)} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right), \quad \chi_ {+} ^ {(z)} = \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

(时测量自旋角动量沿 $x$ 方向的分量得到 $+ \hbar / 2$ 的几率，将 $_ x$ 方向的本征态与 $t$ 时刻的自旋态相乘的模平方，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} P _ {+} ^ {(x)} \left(t\right) = \left| \chi_ {+} ^ {(x) \dagger} \chi \left(t\right) \right| ^ {2} = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} \cos \left(\alpha / 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \\ \sin \left(\alpha / 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \end{array} \right) \right| ^ {2} \\ = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left[ \cos \left(\alpha / 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} + \sin \left(\alpha / 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \right] \right| ^ {2} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \cos \left(\alpha / 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} + \sin \left(\alpha / 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \right] \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \cdot \left[ \cos (\alpha / 2) e ^ {i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} + \sin (\alpha / 2) e ^ {- i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \cos^ {2} (\alpha / 2) + \sin^ {2} (\alpha / 2) + \sin (\alpha / 2) \cos (\alpha / 2) \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \gamma B _ {0} t}\right) \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ 1 + 2 \sin (\alpha / 2) \cos (\alpha / 2) \cos (\gamma B _ {0} t) \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} [ 1 + \sin \alpha \cos (\gamma B _ {0} t) ]. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) (a) 中思路，测量自旋角动量沿 $y$ 方向的分量得到 $+ \hbar / 2$ 的几率是

$$
\begin{array}{l} P_{+}^{(y)}\left(t\right) = \left|\chi_{+}^{(y)\dagger}\chi \right|^{2} = \left|\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\bigg( \begin{array}{cc}1 & -\mathrm{i} \end{array} \bigg)\left( \begin{array}{c}\cos \left(\alpha /2\right)\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}\gamma B_{0}t / 2}\\ \sin \left(\alpha /2\right)\mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i}\gamma B_{0}t / 2} \end{array} \right)\right|^{2} \\ = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left[ \cos \frac {\alpha}{2} e ^ {i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} - i \sin (\alpha / 2) e ^ {- i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \right] \right| ^ {2} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \cos (\alpha / 2) e ^ {- i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} + i \sin (\alpha / 2) e ^ {i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \right] \\ \cdot \left[ \cos (\alpha / 2) e ^ {i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} - i \sin (\alpha / 2) e ^ {- i \gamma B _ {0} t / 2} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \cos^ {2} (\alpha / 2) + \sin^ {2} (\alpha / 2) + i \sin (\alpha / 2) \cos (\alpha / 2) \left(e ^ {i \gamma B _ {0} t} - e ^ {- i \gamma B _ {0} t}\right) \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ 1 - 2 \sin (\alpha / 2) \cos (\alpha / 2) \sin (\gamma B _ {0} t) \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ 1 - \sin \alpha \sin \left(\gamma B _ {0} t\right) \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

(c) 同理，得

$$
P_{+}^{(z)}\left(t\right) = \left|\chi_{+}^{(z)\dagger}\chi \right|^{2} = \bigg|\left( \begin{array}{cc}1 & 0 \end{array} \right)\left( \begin{array}{c}\cos \left(\alpha /2\right)\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}\gamma B_{0}t / 2}\\ \sin \left(\alpha /2\right)\mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i}\gamma B_{0}t / 2} \end{array} \right)\bigg|^{2} = \left|\cos \frac{\alpha}{2}\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}\gamma B_{0}t / 2}\right|^{2} = \cos^{2}\frac{\alpha}{2}.
$$

**习题 4.36 电子静止在振荡磁场中

\boldsymbol {B} = B _ {0} \cos (\omega t) \hat {k},
$$

构造该体系的哈密顿矩阵.   
(b) 相对于 $x$ 轴，开始时 ${ t = 0 }$ 时)电子自旋向上(即 $\chi \left( 0 \right) = \chi _ { + } ^ { ( x ) }$ · 求以后任意时刻的 $\chi \left( t \right)$ 注意 这是一个含时的哈密顿量，所以无法使用通常从定态求解得到 $\chi \left( t \right)$ 的方法.幸运的是，本题可以直接求解舍时薛定谆方程(方程 (4.162)).  
(c) 如果对 $S _ { x }$ 进行测量，求得到 $- \hbar / 2$ 的几率.答案:

$$
\sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\gamma B _ {0}}{2 \omega} \sin (\omega t)\right).
$$

(d) 要使 $S _ { x }$ 完全翻转所需要的最小磁场 $\left( B _ { 0 } \right)$ 是多少?

解答在 $S _ { z }$ 的表象中讨论问题.

(8) $\pmb { \mathcal { H } } = - \gamma \pmb { B } \cdot \pmb { S }$ 对于电子 $\gamma = - e / m$ 若磁场措 $z$ 轴方向

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} = - \gamma \boldsymbol {B} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} = \frac {e}{m} B _ {0} \cos (\omega t)   S _ {z} = \frac {\hbar e}{2 m} B _ {0} \cos (\omega t)   \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

(b) 设自旋波函数为

$$
\chi \left(t\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c} a \left(t\right) \\ b \left(t\right) \end{array} \right),
$$

官满足含时薛定诗方程

$$
\mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\mathrm {d} \chi (t)}{\mathrm {d} t} = H \chi (t),
$$

ep

$$
\begin{array}{l} \mathrm {i} \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c} \mathrm {d} a / \mathrm {d} t \\ \mathrm {d} b / \mathrm {d} t \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar e}{2 m} B _ {0} \cos (\omega t) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a (t) \\ b (t) \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar e}{2 m} B _ {0} \cos (\omega t) \left( \begin{array}{c} a (t) \\ - b (t) \end{array} \right), \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\mathrm {i d} a / \mathrm {d} t = \frac {e}{2 m} B _ {0} \cos (\omega t) a (t),
$$

$$
\mathrm {i d} b / \mathrm {d} t = - \frac {e}{2 m} B _ {0} \cos (\omega t) b (t),
$$

解出

$$
a \left(t\right) = a _ {0} \exp \left(- \mathrm {i} \frac {e B _ {0}}{2 m \omega} \sin \left(\omega t\right)\right),
$$

$$
b \left(t\right) = b _ {0} \exp \left(\mathrm {i} \frac {e B _ {0}}{2 m \omega} \sin \left(\omega t\right)\right).
$$

波函数的初始条件是，: $x$ :轴方向上的自旋态为 $\chi \left( 0 \right) = \chi _ { + } ^ { \left( x \right) }$ ，即 $S _ { x }$ 本征值为 $+ { \frac { \hbar } { 2 } }$ 的本征态所以

$$
\chi \left(0\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c} a \left(0\right) \\ b \left(0\right) \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c} a _ {0} \\ b _ {0} \end{array} \right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right), \quad a _ {0} = b _ {0} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}}.
$$

$$
\chi (t) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c} \exp \left(- \mathrm {i} \frac {e B _ {0}}{2 m \omega} \sin (\omega t)\right) \\ \exp \left(\mathrm {i} \frac {e B _ {0}}{2 m \omega} \sin (\omega t)\right) \end{array} \right).
$$

测量 $S _ { x }$ ffJ $- { \frac { \hbar } { 2 } }$ 一;的几率为

$$
\begin{array}{l} P = | \langle \chi_ {-} ^ {x} | \chi (t) \rangle | ^ {2} = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \xi} \\ \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \xi} \end{array} \right) \right| ^ {2} = \left| \frac {1}{2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \xi} - \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \xi}\right) \right| ^ {2} \\ = | - \mathrm {i} \sin \xi | ^ {2} = \sin^ {2} \xi = \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {e B _ {0}}{2 m \omega} \sin (\omega t)\right) = \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\gamma B _ {0}}{2 \omega} \sin (\omega t)\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

(d)要使 $S _ { x }$ 完全翻转，即测量 $S _ { x }$ 得到 $- { \frac { \hbar } { 2 } }$ 的几率为 $P = 1$ ，所以

$$
\frac {e B _ {0}}{2 m \omega} \sin (\omega t) = \frac {\pi}{2},
$$

最小磁场为

$$
B _ {0} = \frac {m \omega \pi}{e}.
$$

# 事习题 4.37

(b) $S _ { \pm }$ 作用到 $| 0 0 \rangle$ 上(方程 (4.176)) ，并确认你得到军.  
(c) 证明: 111) $| 1 \ - 1 \rangle$ (方程 (4.175)) $S ^ { 2 }$ 具有适当本征值的本征态.

解答 (8)

$$
\begin{array}{l} S _ {-} | 1 0 \rangle = \left(S _ {-} ^ {(1)} + S _ {-} ^ {(2)}\right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\uparrow \downarrow + \downarrow \uparrow) \\ = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left[ \left(S _ {-} ^ {(1)} \uparrow\right) \downarrow + \uparrow \left(S _ {-} ^ {(2)} \downarrow\right) + \left(S _ {-} ^ {(1)} \downarrow\right) \uparrow + \downarrow \left(S _ {-} ^ {(2)} \uparrow\right) \right], \\ \end{array}
$$

因为 $S _ { - } \uparrow = \hbar \downarrow , S _ { - } \downarrow = 0$ ，所以

$$
S _ {-} | 1 0 \rangle = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} [ \hbar \downarrow \downarrow + 0 + 0 + \hbar \downarrow \downarrow ] = \sqrt {2} \hbar | 1 - 1 \rangle .
$$

(b)

$$
\begin{array}{l} S _ {\pm} | 0 0 \rangle = \left(S _ {\pm} ^ {(1)} + S _ {\pm} ^ {(2)}\right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\uparrow \downarrow - \downarrow \uparrow) \\ = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left[ \left(S _ {\pm} ^ {(1)} \uparrow\right) \downarrow + \uparrow \left(S _ {\pm} ^ {(2)} \downarrow\right) - \left(S _ {\pm} ^ {(1)} \downarrow\right) \uparrow - \downarrow \left(S _ {\pm} ^ {(2)} \uparrow\right) \right], \\ \end{array}
$$

因为 $S _ { + } ~ \uparrow { = } ~ 0 , S _ { + } ~ \downarrow { = } ~ \hbar \uparrow$ ，所以

$$
S _ {+} | 0 0 \rangle = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (0 + \hbar \uparrow \uparrow - \hbar \uparrow \uparrow - 0) = 0, S _ {-} | 0 0 \rangle = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\hbar \downarrow \downarrow + 0 - 0 - \hbar \downarrow \downarrow) = 0.
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} S ^ {2} | 1 1 \rangle = \left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} + \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)} \right] \uparrow \uparrow \\ = \left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} \uparrow \right] \uparrow + \uparrow \left[ \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} \uparrow \right] + 2 \left(S _ {x} ^ {(1)} \uparrow\right) \left(S _ {x} ^ {(2)} \uparrow\right) \\ + 2 \left(S _ {y} ^ {(1)} \uparrow\right) \left(S _ {y} ^ {(2)} \uparrow\right) + 2 \left(S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \uparrow\right) \left(S _ {z} ^ {(2)} \uparrow\right) \\ = \frac {3 \hbar^ {3}}{4} \uparrow \uparrow + \frac {3 \hbar^ {3}}{4} \uparrow \uparrow + 2 \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow + 2 \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{2} \downarrow \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{2} \downarrow + 2 \frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow \frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow \\ = 2 \hbar^ {2} \uparrow \uparrow \\ = 2 \hbar^ {2} | 1 1 \rangle , \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} S ^ {2} | 1 - 1 \rangle = \left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} + \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)} \right] \downarrow \downarrow \\ = \left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} \downarrow \right] \downarrow + \downarrow \left[ \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} \downarrow \right] + 2 \left(S _ {x} ^ {(1)} \downarrow\right) \left(S _ {x} ^ {(2)} \downarrow\right) \\ + 2 \left(S _ {y} ^ {(1)} \downarrow\right) \left(S _ {y} ^ {(2)} \downarrow\right) + 2 \left(S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \downarrow\right) \left(S _ {z} ^ {(2)} \downarrow\right) \\ = \frac {3 \hbar^ {3}}{4} \downarrow \downarrow + \frac {3 \hbar^ {3}}{4} \downarrow \downarrow + 2 \frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow \frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow + 2 \left(- \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{2} \uparrow\right) \left(- \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{2} \uparrow\right) + 2 \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow\right) \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow\right) \\ = 2 \hbar^ {2} \downarrow \downarrow = 2 \hbar^ {2} | 1 - 1 \rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$
